button.name: action_reopen
button.confirm: Reopening withdraws this task's completion: its delivery date is cleared and it drops back into the pipeline. Continue?

button.name: action_reset_stage
button.confirm: Reset THIS stage? Its inputs — drive link, QC results, scores and notes for this stage only — will be permanently erased and the stage starts again from the beginning. Other stages are unchanged. This cannot be undone.

button.name: action_reset_task
button.confirm: Reset the ENTIRE task? Every stage input — drive links, QC results, scores and notes — will be permanently erased, any later stage will be DELETED, and the task will start again from Tasker QC. Its Task ID, persona, tasker and leads are kept. This cannot be undone.
